svg.title: Autohive agent runtime
svg.desc: Commands go from Autohive's execution engine through the root supervisor to an unprivileged runner. The runner accesses files through bind mounts and rclone's FUSE mount, backed by Autohive's WebDAV endpoint. Its HTTP and HTTPS requests are redirected by eBPF to the supervisor proxy, then to the Autohive credential gateway, which adds provider credentials outside the VM. Arrows show request direction; responses return along the same paths.
